  {"step":2,"file":"tests/fuzzer/flatbuffers_monster_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":97,"var":"input","code":"auto input = std::string(original.c_str());","note":"The input is truncated at the first NUL and becomes the exact JSON text that will be parsed."},
  {"step":3,"file":"tests/fuzzer/flatbuffers_monster_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":103,"var":"opts.allow_non_utf8","code":"opts.allow_non_utf8 = (flags & flags_allow_non_utf8);","note":"The first flag byte controls parser options, including whether non-UTF-8 bytes are accepted into string fields."},
  {"step":4,"file":"tests/fuzzer/flatbuffers_monster_fuzzer.cc","function":"do_test","line":63,"var":"input_json","code":"if (parser.ParseJson(input_json.c_str())) {","note":"The attacker-controlled JSON is parsed into a FlatBuffer using the loaded Monster schema."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/idl_parser.cpp","function":"Parser::ParseString","line":1070,"var":"attribute_","code":"auto s = attribute_; EXPECT(kTokenStringConstant);","note":"String field contents are taken directly from the JSON token and stored for serialization."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/idl_parser.cpp","function":"Parser::ParseString","line":1073,"var":"val.constant","code":"val.constant = NumToString(builder_.CreateString(s).o);","note":"The string bytes are copied into the FlatBuffer builder, preserving attacker-controlled contents."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/idl_gen_text.cpp","function":"GenStruct","line":295,"var":"output_anyway","code":"auto output_anyway = (opts.output_default_scalars_in_json || fd.key) && IsScalar(fd.value.type.base_type) && !fd.deprecated;","note":"When the buffer is printed back, scalar fields are emitted and string fields are read back from the buffer."},
  {"step":8,"file":"include/flatbuffers/base.h","function":"ReadScalar","line":406,"var":"*reinterpret_cast<const T *>(p)","code":"return EndianScalar(*reinterpret_cast<const T *>(p));","note":"The sink performs typed loads from the buffer; if the string or scalar bytes are malformed or uninitialized, this read can surface the MSan issue."}
]
